description: A workspace's channels: every public one, and the private ones the app was invited to, with channel_id and whether the app is a member. limit up to 1,000 and cursor to page. -- MakeHybrid API plan, GET /slack/v1/workspaces/{team_id}/channels, group slack.

query.description: Optional query-string parameters, e.g. {"limit":"20","cursor":"..."}. Values are coerced to strings.

team_id.description: Value for the {team_id} segment of /slack/v1/workspaces/{team_id}/channels. Required; pass it raw (it is URL-escaped for you).
